description: Four-channel mixer with two mono channels and two stereo ones, feeding a main stereo pair and a headphone jack

params.text: Pans that mono channel between the two main outputs on a constant-power law
Sets that channel's level on an audio taper, silent at the bottom and unity at the top
Chooses the output level: MOD. leaves the mix at modular level, LINE drops it by 16.2dB for line inputs
Sets the level of the headphone output, after the main level knob
Sets the level of the main outputs, and of the headphone output before it

inputs.text: The mono signal for that channel, panned by the knob beside it
The left side of that stereo channel, and the whole of it when the R jack is empty
The right side of that stereo channel; with nothing patched it takes whatever is in the L jack beside it

outputs.text: A mono sum of the left and right mix, at the level set by the headphone knob
The left side of the mix, clamped at 11V either way
The right side of the mix, clamped at 11V either way

notes: The mix is doubled before it reaches the outputs, so two channels at unity already push the main jacks toward their 11V clamp.

inputs.3:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the CH 3 left input.
inputs.5:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the CH 4 left input.
